json-root-array-catalog-v1.description: Parse a root JSON array as structural catalogue rows without interpreting values.

json-object-results-v1.description: Parse a JSON object with one declared results-array path and preserve object, array, key, and depth structure.

json-object-aggregate-v1.description: Parse a JSON aggregate object and declared arrays without treating aggregate keys or values as a complete institutional denominator.

json-object-vocabulary-v1.description: Parse nested JSON vocabulary maps as key and type structure without treating categories as observed action rows.

json-object-envelope-v1.description: Parse a JSON response envelope and declared arrays while preserving nested structural custody.

html-document-v1.description: Token-count frozen HTML bytes with a deterministic non-DOM parser; scripts are not executed and text is not semantically classified.

html-http-error-v1.description: Token-count a frozen HTTP-error HTML body while retaining the error response as an access outcome rather than record absence.

credential-boundary-v1.description: Preserve a credential or lawful-access boundary without manufacturing a response or parse tree.
